purpose: Retrospective dependence-aware reassessment of the complete pre-v3 SBS-EA pipeline under the final whole-method objective.
estimand: Comparator minus LLM-source mean relative gap for the complete fixed downstream path.

inference.repeated_seed_rule: Average repeated seed/rotation observations within each physical instance before inference.

decision_rule.pass: Every required comparator has a strictly positive physical-instance bootstrap lower bound.
decision_rule.component_policy: The equal-budget no-operator result is a mechanism limitation and mandatory disclosure, not a veto on whole-method effectiveness.

mandatory_disclosures: Ten temperature-zero calls yielded one unique source payload.
The LLM payload contains executable expressions admitted by the validator.
The historical source/deployment gate is not used as evidence that EA operators independently cause the gain.
The no-operator audit found a mean full-EA advantage of only 0.0004004 on 21 physical instances.
